page_title: NET 3-1 USA | Netherlands v USA 03/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Cody Gakpo goes off the pitch and Wout Weghorst (Netherlands) comes on.
90+3' Louis van Gaal has decided to substitute Nathan Ake and he is replaced by Matthijs de Ligt (Netherlands).
90+2' The substitution is prepared. Jordan Morris (USA) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antonee Robinson.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Giovanni Reyna (USA) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
87' Wilton Sampaio shows a yellow card to Frenkie de Jong (Netherlands) for a tough tackle.
86' Walker Zimmerman (USA) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
86' The referee awards a corner and Christian Pulisic (USA) goes over to take it.

86' Haji Wright (USA) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. USA force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
85' DeAndre Yedlin (USA) makes a strong challenge and Wilton Sampaio blows for a foul.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Xavi Simons (Netherlands) will replace Memphis Depay.

81' 3 - 1 Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) meets a perfect cross from Daley Blind deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the left post. It's 3:1.
80' Christian Pulisic (USA) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
80' Antonee Robinson (USA) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Now USA have a corner.
79' It's a nice effort by Christian Pulisic (USA) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Andries Noppert. Easy save.
78' Steven Bergwijn (Netherlands) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post.
78' Andries Noppert displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Haji Wright (USA) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

76' 2 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Christian Pulisic, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Haji Wright (USA), who beats Andries Noppert with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 2:1.
75' Christian Pulisic (USA) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
75' Substitution. DeAndre Yedlin (USA) on for Sergino Dest.

75' Haji Wright (USA) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal despite being in a difficult position, but his shot is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, USA are going to take it.
74' Giovanni Reyna (USA) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies well wide of the left post.
72' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Haji Wright (USA) heads on.

71' Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Matt Turner makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! Memphis Depay (Netherlands) tries to nod in a rebound. His close-range effort is denied by the goalkeeper, who pulls off a stunning save.
71' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Virgil van Dijk (Netherlands) sends a wild header high over the bar.
71' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) will take a corner kick.
70' The ball is cleared after Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and Netherlands manage to earn a corner.
69' Brenden Aaronson (USA) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Antonee Robinson (USA) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
67' Gregg Berhalter decides to make a substitution. Weston McKennie will be replaced by Haji Wright (USA).
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Timothy Weah as he is replaced by Brenden Aaronson (USA).
65' Antonee Robinson (USA) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
63' Timothy Weah (USA) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
62' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) takes the corner with a short pass.

62' Memphis Depay (Netherlands) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Matt Turner pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Netherlands.
61' Christian Pulisic (USA) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
60' Wilton Sampaio shows a yellow card to Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) for his blatant foul.
59' The free kick from Christian Pulisic (USA) is cleared away from danger by one of the defenders.
59' Virgil van Dijk (Netherlands) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. USA earn a free kick.
57' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Netherlands.
55' Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle as Steven Bergwijn (Netherlands) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
54' Giovanni Reyna plays the ball through an opponents legs to Weston McKennie (USA), who shoots from the edge of the box. The keeper scrambles across his line but the shot rises just over the bar.
53' Christian Pulisic (USA) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Andries Noppert.
51' Excellent touch by Sergino Dest (USA)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.

50' The ball from the corner kick lands at the feet of Tim Ream (USA) deep inside the box and he takes a shot. The strike heads towards the right post, but it's deflected away thanks to a wonderful intervention by one of the defenders.
49' Christian Pulisic (USA) will deliver the corner kick.
49' Timothy Weah (USA) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to USA.
46' Gregg Berhalter has made a change at the break. Giovanni Reyna has come on in place of Jesus Ferreira (USA).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Louis van Gaal probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Marten de Roon (Netherlands). He is replaced by Steven Bergwijn.
46' Half-time substitution. Davy Klaassen is replaced by Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' 0 - 1 Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' 2 - 0 Goal! Daley Blind (Netherlands) takes a short pass from Denzel Dumfries in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot inside the left post. 2:0.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Sergino Dest (USA) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
43' Timothy Weah (USA) sends a rebound goalwards towards the right-hand post, but the goalkeeper stretches to stop it.
40' Wilton Sampaio couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jurrien Timber (Netherlands) and blew his whistle.
39' Christian Pulisic (USA) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for USA.
37' Christian Pulisic (USA) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
33' A long pass, executed by Tim Ream (USA), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
31' Jurrien Timber (Netherlands) brings an opponent down and Wilton Sampaio interrupts the game.
29' The corner from Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) is hurriedly cleared.
29' Virgil van Dijk (Netherlands) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Netherlands can continue in their attacking effort.
28' Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) is about to take a corner kick.
28' Memphis Depay (Netherlands) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Netherlands.
26' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 1:0.
23' The USA players are exchanging some short passes.
21' Memphis Depay (Netherlands) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
20' Christian Pulisic (USA) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

18' Matt Turner doesn't have to worry about this one. Cody Gakpo plays a pass into the feet of Daley Blind (Netherlands), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes high over the bar.
17' A pass into the penalty area from Antonee Robinson (USA) is intercepted by the defence.
14' Wilton Sampaio blows his whistle. Denzel Dumfries (Netherlands) commits a foul after dangerous play.
13' Christian Pulisic (USA) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Jesus Ferreira, but he can't get on the end of the pass.

10' 1 - 0 Goal! Great play by Denzel Dumfries releases Memphis Depay (Netherlands) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
7' Christian Pulisic (USA) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Netherlands will have a goal kick.

7' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Antonee Robinson (USA), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to USA.
4' Christian Pulisic (USA) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

3' Christian Pulisic (USA) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Andries Noppert inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the right side of the target, but was denied by a great save.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Netherlands will have the kick-off.
Wilton Sampaio will referee today's match.
